items.title: File Widerspruch against partial refusal of window permit
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Hansestadt Beispielwismar, Am Markt 1, 23966 Beispielwismar.
items.computation: Bescheiddatum (posting day) = 19.11.2026 (Thursday). Letter states delivery fiction is the 4th day after posting (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V). Counting from 19.11. as day 0 (not counted): day1=20.11., day2=21.11., day3=22.11., day4=23.11.2026 (Monday) → deemed delivered. This is a general municipal authority, not a tax office, so even if the 4th day fell on a weekend/holiday it would not move – but 23.11.2026 is a Monday anyway, no adjustment needed. The one-month Widerspruch period runs from this delivery day under §§ 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the delivery day itself (23.11.) is not counted, so the period ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in MV, so no further shift under § 31 Abs.3 VwVfG/§193 BGB is needed.
